pages.title: Starting
pages.text: Place an Ancient Book in Decipher to begin deciphering and breaking its array.

pages.title: Rotating Runes
pages.text: $(bold)Left-click$() a rune to rotate it counterclockwise.$(br)$(bold)Right-click$() to rotate it clockwise.$(br2)Each valid rotation consumes a random 3 to 8 runes from the nearby table.

pages.title: Connection Rules
pages.text: The board contains a 6x4 array. Every opening must align with the neighboring cell, and all runes must form one complete network from the array's heart.$(br2)Connected paths carry flowing golden light. A gap, one-sided connection, or isolated branch means the array is not solved.
